items.name: theme
items.title: vizcn theme tokens
items.description: Structural --vz-* tokens (core light/dark + terminal + paper). Namespaced: installing vizcn never repaints your app.

items.name: palette
items.title: vizcn series palette
items.description: Brand-neutral categorical/ordinal series colors (seriesColor, RAMP, HEAT).

items.name: motion
items.title: vizcn motion (optional)
items.description: Pure-CSS entrance/interaction kit (vc-* classes). Forms render fine without it.

items.name: bench-matrix
items.title: Bench Matrix
items.description: Vendor-announcement style benchmark board: benchmark rows grouped by domain vs model columns, with a tinted hero column and bold best-in-row plates.

items.name: bubble-field
items.title: Bubble Field
items.description: Two-axis scatter with optional log10 scales, square-root bubble sizing, categorical color, decade gridlines, and computed legend counts.

items.name: delta-bars
items.title: Delta Bars
items.description: Diverging daily delta ribbon for a pair of rivals — bars rise above the zero midline when A leads, drop below when B leads.

items.name: dumbbell-range
items.title: Dumbbell Range
items.description: Two endpoints per row joined by a connector on a shared zero-based scale — the dumbbell genre for paired values like min/max or input/output.

items.name: dune-flow
items.title: Dune Flow
items.description: Smooth B-spline stacked area flow showing what a stream was made of and when the waves came.

items.name: frontier-board
items.title: Frontier Board
items.description: Interactive score-vs-cost scatter where each model's effort levels connect into an efficiency frontier line, with metric/version toggles, model filter, and hover focus.

items.name: heat-strip
items.title: Heat Strip
items.description: A year of weekly activity as one strip of thin bars — numbers row above (total / peak / current week), per-week hover tooltip, intensity doubled by opacity.

items.name: leaderboard-bars
items.title: Leaderboard Bars
items.description: Horizontal pass-rate bars with ±std whiskers, a gridded 0–100 axis, secondary metric columns, and an out-of-competition row below a hard rule.

items.name: leaderboard-table
items.title: Leaderboard Table
items.description: Score bars with +/-std whiskers plus numeric economy columns (cost/tokens/steps), one row per model run, with version and Best/All-effort-levels toggles, model filter, and rank-morphing rows.

items.name: paired-bars
items.title: Paired Bars
items.description: Grouped horizontal bars for exactly two measurements per subject, sharing one gridded scale and one entity hue.

items.name: rank-bars
items.title: Rank Bars
items.description: Horizontal ranking bars — label, zero-based bar, value — with an accent-highlighted hero row.

items.name: rank-slope
items.title: Rank Slope
items.description: Two-context slopegraph with a shared linear scale, per-item color, and deterministically de-collided endpoint labels.

items.name: share-strip
items.title: Share Strip
items.description: One hard-bordered 100% strip with in-segment labels for larger parts and a complete value-and-percent legend.

items.name: stacked-activity
items.title: Stacked Activity Bars
items.description: Interactive stacked daily columns with a live legend that doubles as the tooltip; the last, incomplete day is hatched.

items.name: treemap
items.title: Treemap
items.description: Flat slice-and-dice treemap in N rows — tile area is proportional to each item's share of the total; tiles carry label, value, optional icon, badge, and link.

items.name: value-columns
items.title: Value Columns
items.description: Plain vertical columns comparing magnitudes — value on top, zero-based column, label below — with an accent-highlighted hero column.

items.name: verdict-stack
items.title: Verdict Stack
items.description: Interactive 100%-normalized outcome stacks with a grouped taxonomy legend that highlights one verdict across all subjects.
